name: Branding
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and Branding.
Select desktop and mobile logos, then a favicon and social share image. Set heading and body fonts before adjusting sizes and line heights.
Set base background and text as a pair. Review the separate button, badge, muted text, and dark-mode pairs. Section overrides can keep their own colors.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.label: Body size (rem ×100)
settings.info: Global typography default. Sections with custom typography retain priority. 100 = 1rem.
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust body size (rem ×100). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions. This editor value is scaled by 100: 150 means 1.5, in the unit shown in the label.
